name: Null, Missing, and Empty Value Concepts
description: Distinctions between database NULL, Python None, JavaScript null/undefined, SAS missing (. and .A-.Z), empty string, and NaN.
when_to_retrieve: When migrating conditional checks (e.g. IF var THEN / WHERE col IS NULL / if val:)
When translating filter predicates and join logic
When converting SAS missing values or SQL NULL columns to Python
when_not_to_retrieve: When handling strictly non-nullable primitive operations
retrieval_guidance: In SAS, missing numeric values evaluate as smaller than any negative number (.-Z < . < -1e308). In Python, None < 0 raises TypeError.
